name: Inkling 2 Small (594B)

release_date.note: model card; weights on Hugging Face from a 2026-11-12 update

moe.router: sigmoid scores; a learned bias only steers the top-8 choice; weights renormalised, times 8

steps.label: attention input: learned mix of earlier block outputs (3 queries on global layers, one each for q, k, v)
input_layernorm (global layers: separate q, k and v input norms)

k and v pass short convs (taps partly per token on global layers); q, k L2-clipped; values RMS-normed; learned relative bias; sink logit; sigmoid output gate; local: window 1024 / global: full, log-length scaling
skipped at a block boundary (every 6th layer), where the block input is stored instead
MLP input: learned mix of earlier block outputs
top-8 of 384 SwiGLU experts, gate and up soft-capped (4, 25), no shared expert

specials.name: short_conv
specials.what: four depthwise causal convolutions of kernel 4 per layer, each with its own skip: on keys and on values, on the attention output and on the MoE output; the sum is scaled by 1/sqrt(5), or by 1/3 for the key and value convs of global layers, whose taps add a per-token part projected from the input

specials.name: attention_residuals
specials.what: block attention residuals; 6 layers per block (8 blocks); attn_res queries per sublayer plus one output query
specials.where: between sublayers and before the head

specials.name: mlp_softcap
specials.what: gate capped at 4, up projection at 25

specials.name: relative_bias
specials.what: learned relative-position term: d_rel 16, extent 1024 tokens, L2-clipped at 8

specials.name: log_length_scaling
specials.what: scores scaled with log context length (alpha 0.1, floor 128,000)

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: 5-layer multi-token head, block size 8, reads layers 5, 11, ... 48; uses RoPE (theta 1e6)

omitted_towers.what: ViT based on Perception Encoder; 20x20 patches, 2x2 pooling

post.note: vision encoder, no audio, context phases, weights update 2026-11-12

idx.note: tensor names show which parts each layer has; order is inferred

rgal.note: card listed on the live page; not in the models.yml snapshot; fact sheet not read

code.note: added 2026-11-12 (PR 50682): Inkling2SlidingDecoderLayer, Inkling2FullDecoderLayer, ShortConvolution, BlockAttentionResidual, SoftcappedSwiGLU, TopKRouter

ccode.note: defaults: hidden_act silu, scoring_func sigmoid, conv_kernel_size 4

figure_links.author: Sebastian Raschka
figure_links.title: Inkling 2 Small (594B), the screenshot diagram
figure_links.terms: no reuse licence stated; link only

unknowns.ffn.hidden_dim: no dense FFN layers: every layer holds experts
unknowns.attention.position.theta: main stack has no RoPE in config; only the MTP head lists rope_theta

notes: Announcement first said closed weights on Tinker; a 2026-11-12 update put weights on Hugging Face. The card and README say Apache 2.0.
An earlier version of this record placed the short convolutions before the sublayers, read from tensor names; transformers' inkling2 code applies them to the sublayer outputs, as in Inkling.

global.note: full context; relative bias extent 1024; log-length scaling; separate q/k/v input norms; key and value convs with per-token taps
